scenarios.name: same_level_peer
scenarios.refusal: X2.observer:Day names same_instant(X_MARK, P9), which X1.emitter:Day emits in its own level (merge m0): a same-level peer is never visible (SimError::InstantCause(same_level))

scenarios.name: absent_target
scenarios.refusal: X3.prober:Day names same_instant(DEATH, P77), but no DEATH about P77 was merged before its level this instant (SimError::InstantCause(absent))

scenarios.name: ambiguous
scenarios.refusal: X2.observer:Day names same_instant(X_MARK, P9), which matches 2 events [0, 1]: name one with the direct read (SimError::InstantCause(ambiguous))

scenarios.name: undeclared_kind
scenarios.refusal: X3.prober:Day names BIRTH, which is not in its [[observes]] ['DEATH'] (SimError::UndeclaredObserve)

scenarios.name: death_then_reentry
scenarios.refusal: M2.demography:Day inserts P4, whose ledger row is still there (dead this instant, a row stays until Bookkeeping's compaction): SimError::Ledger, the duplicate-id refusal of SPR-014's insert_rows

scenarios.name: reentry_after_compaction
scenarios.refusal: M2.demography:Day inserts P4, who exited this instant: no re-entry within an instant, SimError::Ledger (EVO-002 §2.3)
